profile.text: Puzzle, a Victorian military intelligence officer, came to Rhodes Island with a letter from the Duke of Caster, seeking treatment as an Infected. He has reached a cooperation agreement with Rhodes Island, and is active in various operations and preliminary intelligence gathering while receiving treatment.
